title: International New Venture

exam.type: Essay: two case questions, answered with course theories and practical or proven methods

shelf_blurb: All fourteen sessions of International New Venture, from entrepreneurship and opportunity recognition to business models, prototyping and protecting intellectual property abroad, with the EuroDisneyland, LocalBite and FreshMart cases, 271 flashcards, an 88-question quiz and a case-based mock exam.
